top_signals.title: Bank of Japan is expected to hold rates this week — but stay hawkish: CNBC survey
top_signals.summary: All survey respondents said they expect the BOJ to set the stage for a rate hike in December or January, as inflation and wages continue to rise.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Gold Steadies Near $4,000 as Inflation Keeps Rate-Hike Bets Firm
top_signals.summary: Gold steadied near $4,000 an ounce, and was on track for a second monthly loss, as energy-led inflation raised the prospects for a US rate increase before year-end.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Yuan Gaining 10% as Global Push Deepens
top_signals.summary: China’s push to internationalize the yuan has entered a “steady, slow, but nonstop” phase that is likely to support further gains in the currency, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ANA holdings to fully acquire parent of two midsize airlines
top_signals.summary: ANA Holdings is exploring the possibility of operating the two airlines under the ANA brand in the medium term.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
